end.summary:
- Practised grouping animals as plant-eaters, meat-eaters, and both; examples included cow, lion, and animals eating seeds and insects.
- Practised predicting changes when an animal or other living thing is removed from a food chain; this still needs checking next time.
- Practised building and reading food chains with arrows; the arrow mix-up was corrected later using algae → larvae → fish.
- Practised that plants make their own food using sunlight, water, and air and begin food chains; this still needs checking next time.
end.parentNote: Asha practised animal diets, food-chain changes, arrows, and how plants make their own food. Manav used reasons such as teeth and eating relationships, and corrected the arrow mix-up later by reading algae → larvae → fish; the meaning of arrows and plant roles still need more checking. At home, try making one three-step chain together and ask, “What does each arrow show?”

kyunki paudhe apna khaana khud bana lete hain... dhoop, paani aur hawa se. jaanwar aisa nahi kar sakte. isliye unko paudhe khane padte hain, ya phir jo paudhe khaye unko.
